# PPTX fixtures

Generated for this project (no third-party content):

- `python-pptx.pptx` — `python3 make_fixtures.py python-pptx.pptx` (python-pptx 1.0):
  title + bullets with levels, notes, preset shapes (rotation), a picture,
  a table, a group, a hyperlink and a chart.
- `libreoffice.pptx` — the same file re-saved by LibreOffice 24.2.
